cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Hold this bucket under the seascape. I'll get towels before the gallery floor floods.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is a painting leaking? I said we should buy a print.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You can choose the replacement. Tilt the bucket toward the waves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are there fish? This bucket's nearly full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fetch the aquarium from reception. I'll hold this one until you're back.
